svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: igotbusted
g.desc: 💣💙 HAPPY BIRTHDAY, TRAP! 🎂✨ Hope your birthday is as wild, unpredictable, and explosive as Jinx herself! 💥 May your day be filled with crazy adventures, endless laughter, unexpected surprises, and absolutely zero boring moments. Keep being your wonderfully chaotic self, breaking the rules, making noise, and leaving a little madness wherever you go. 💙💜 Here's to another year of being the main character, causing harmless chaos, and making life a little less ordinary! Stay crazy, stay iconic, and remember... rules are made to be blown up! 💣 Have an explosive birthday, TRAP! 🎉💙

g.title: dey
